layout.arrangement: Entire slide enclosed in a dark-red rectangular border on a light-gray background. Title and yellow slide-number circle sit top-right. A vertical pipeline runs down the top-center: small word-embedding strip (Y₂) → 'Linear Transformation [T]' box → long 5-segment 'Concatenated Vector' strip. Below, five overlapping rounded-rectangle 'head' layers cascade from front-bottom-left (h=1, red, fully detailed) to back-top-right (h=5, peach, mostly occluded). A thick red curved arrow labeled '+H* Heads' climbs the right side from the h=1 output back up toward the concatenated vector. A green dashed legend box (W matrix dimensions) sits bottom-right; a red arrow bottom-left points at the highlighted Y₂ cell in the bottom input strip.

layout.hierarchy: The 5-layer cascade dominates (~65% of canvas); the front red h=1 layer is the visual focal point (largest, most detailed). Title is bold but secondary. Highest-contrast accents: black h=n pills, thick red arrow, gold W boxes, red X₂/d×H·d/Concatenated Vector text. Dozens of tiny multicolor cell strips give fine texture.

visual_elements.description: Top pipeline: small embedding strip (~4 cells, green/yellow/pink; 'Y₂' in the yellow cell; label '1×1d' right) → black arrow down → white bordered box 'Linear Transformation [ T ]' with red 'd×H·d' at bottom-right corner → black arrow down → long 'Concatenated Vector' strip (red label, '1×dH' beneath) made of 5 dashed-border segments: Y₁ᴴ (orange-red fill), Y₂ᴴ (dark gray fill), Y₃ᴴ (yellow fill), Y₄ᴴ (green fill), Y₅ᴴ (pale-yellow fill); thin dashed gray lines drop from the segments toward the head layers below

Five overlapping rounded-rectangle head layers cascading front-bottom-left → back-top-right, each tagged with a black pill (white text): h=1 salmon-red (front, x≈7-63%, y≈45-95%), h=2 lavender, h=3 yellow, h=4 green, h=5 peach (back, x≈25-82%, y≈31-62%), each rear layer offset ~3-4% up-right. Every rear layer shows a white 'Similarity' pill (green outline), a white 'Weighted SUM' pill (green outline), green-dashed input/output vector strips labeled X₁–X₄ on its right edge, and (visible on h=2 and h=3 bottom edges) gold 'Wₖᴴ' and 'Wᵥᴴ' boxes plus a red 'W_qᴴ' box

h=1 (front red layer) detailed mechanism, left→right: (a) four green-dashed input strips stacked vertically labeled X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄ (top→bottom), each a row of green/yellow/pink cells; (b) three gold boxes 'Wₖᴴ' each emitting a tiny strip labeled K₁, K₂, K₃; (c) tan vertical box 'Dot Product' containing a mini node-link graph (blue dots joined by thin gray lines) with labels K₁·q, K₂·q, K₃·q on its left edge; (d) pink vertical box 'Scaling by √d' with stacked fractions K₁·q/√d, K₂·q/√d, K₃·q/√d just above it; (e) lilac vertical box 'Soft max'; (f) white pill 'Similarity' (green outline) above Dot Product, white pill 'Probabilities' above Soft max, white pill 'Weighted SUM' above the Σ block; (g) white box 'Σ' (blue sigma) with three red ⊗ symbols below, joined by red lines to labels V₁, V₂, V₃; (h) three gold boxes 'Wᵥᴴ' producing V₁, V₂, V₃; (i) four green-dashed output strips X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄ at right; (j) bottom: green-dashed 4-cell strip labeled X₁, Y₂ (magenta highlighted cell), X₃, X₄, feeding red box 'W_qᴴ' whose output is a small strip labeled 'q' routed up into Dot Product; (k) thick red arrow at bottom-left pointing at the highlighted Y₂ cell

Thick red curved arrow rising from the h=1 output region (bottom center-right) up the right side toward the Concatenated Vector strip, annotated in blue text '+H* Heads' (indicating the H head outputs are concatenated)

Bottom-right legend in a green dashed rounded rectangle: small vector strip labeled '1×1d' (label above), white square box 'W', '=' sign, second vector strip labeled '1×d·d' (label beneath), red caption 'd: Embedding Length' at bottom — expressing the projection-matrix dimensionality

imagery: No photographs or illustrations — the slide is 100% vector diagram art. Recurring icon-like motifs: multicolor cell strips (green/yellow/pink rectangles representing embedding vectors), gold rectangles for weight matrices, black pills for head labels, white pills with green outlines for operation labels, red ⊗ operators, and a blue-dot node-link sketch inside the Dot Product box.
typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Calibri-like). Title bold, ~24-28pt, black, with red 'X₂' (subscript 2). Box/pill labels bold, ~9-12pt. Red used for emphasis text ('Concatenated Vector', '1×dH', 'd×H·d', 'd: Embedding Length', X₂). Heavy use of subscripts (X₁…X₄, K₁…K₃, V₁…V₃, Y₁…Y₅) and superscript ᴴ for head index; 'W_qᴴ' combines subscript q and superscript H. Mixed case throughout; only 'SUM' in 'Weighted SUM' is capitalized. No numbered bullets; no italics.
animation_state: Slide appears fully built — all five heads (h=1…h=5), all pills, strips and labels are visible; no mid-build reveal detected. The dark strip at the very bottom edge is the video player's progress bar, not slide content.

Top-center: draw a small 4-cell strip (green #B6D7A8, yellow #FFE066, pink #F4CCCC, green) with 'Y₂' in the yellow cell; label '1×1d' in black to its right. 4. Below it, draw a white black-bordered box with bold text 'Linear Transformation    [ T ]' and red 'd×H·d' at its bottom-right corner; connect strip→box→next element with short black down-arrows. 5. Below that, add red bold label 'Concatenated Vector' with red '1×dH' under it; to its right draw a long strip of 5 dashed-border segments colored orange-red, dark gray, yellow, green, pale yellow, labeled Y₁ᴴ, Y₂ᴴ, Y₃ᴴ, Y₄ᴴ, Y₅ᴴ; add thin dashed gray connector lines from the segments down toward the layers. 6. Draw five rounded rectangles cascading from front-bottom-left to back-top-right (each offset ~3-4% up and right): h=1 fill #F08A8A (front), h=2 #C9B8E8, h=3 #F6E96B, h=4 #A8E4A0, h=5 #F8D0A0 (back); on each, place a black pill with white text 'h=1'…'h=5' along its upper-right edge. 7. In the front red h=1 rectangle, build left→right: (a) four green-dashed vector strips labeled X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄ stacked vertically; (b) three gold (#F5C242) boxes 'Wₖᴴ' with tiny output strips labeled K₁, K₂, K₃; (c) tan (#D2B48C) vertical box 'Dot Product' containing 4-5 blue dots joined by thin gray lines, with labels K₁·q, K₂·q, K₃·q on its left; (d) pink (#F2B8C6) vertical box 'Scaling by √d' with fractions K₁·q/√d, K₂·q/√d, K₃·q/√d stacked just above it; (e) lilac (#C9A0DC) vertical box 'Soft max'; (f) white pills with green outlines: 'Similarity' (above Dot Product), 'Probabilities' (above Soft max), 'Weighted SUM' (above Σ block); (g) white box with blue 'Σ' and three red ⊗ symbols below it wired by red lines to labels V₁, V₂, V₃; (h) three gold boxes 'Wᵥᴴ' feeding V₁, V₂, V₃; (i) four green-dashed output strips X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄ at the right edge. 8. Along h=1's bottom: green-dashed 4-cell strip labeled X₁, Y₂, X₃, X₄ with the Y₂ cell filled magenta (#FF69B4); below it a red box 'W_qᴴ' whose output is a small strip labeled 'q' with an arrow up into Dot Product; add a thick red arrow from bottom-left pointing at the Y₂ cell. 9. In each rear layer (h=2…h=5), add the partially visible repeats: 'Similarity' and 'Weighted SUM' pills near each layer's top edge, green-dashed X₁–X₄ strips on each right edge, and on h=2/h=3 bottom edges gold 'Wₖᴴ', 'Wᵥᴴ' boxes plus a red 'W_qᴴ' box (let front layers occlude the rest). 10. Draw a thick red (#C00000) curved arrow from the h=1 output area up the right side toward the Concatenated Vector strip; place blue (#0070C0) text '+H* Heads' along it. 11. Bottom-right: draw a green dashed rounded rectangle containing a small strip labeled '1×1d', a white square box 'W', an '=' sign, a second strip labeled '1×d·d' (label beneath), and red caption 'd: Embedding Length' at the bottom. 12. Use one sans-serif family throughout (Arial/Calibri), bold for title and box labels, ~9-12pt for diagram labels; keep all subscripts/superscripts as in the original.
